meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude会以主持人身份，把每个git工作树、分支或PR当作参会代理，在共享聊天文件中进行多轮对话，对比各自改动，最后产出一份合并计划（指定目标工作树、合并顺序和冲突处理）。全程只读，不实际合并。
howto.when: 当你要求对多个git工作树、分支或PR做站会对比、或要一个统一的合并方案时触发；若候选少于两个会提示扩大范围后停止。

say.text: 帮我对这几个分支开个standup，给出合并顺序。
say.note: Claude会创建房间并让各分支代理发言。

say.text: 对比最近24小时活跃的工作树，产出一份整合计划。
say.note: 按时间窗口筛选参会工作树。

say.text: 对所有打开的PR做个站会，汇总成一个目标分支方案。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a facilitator, treating each git worktree, branch, or PR as an agent participant in a shared markdown chat. It runs rounds of comparison and ends by writing a consolidation plan (target worktree, merge order, conflict resolutions). The room is read-only; no merges happen inside.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a standup-style comparison of multiple git worktrees, branches, or PRs, or for one unified merge plan. If fewer than two candidates exist, Claude says so, offers to widen the scope, and stops.

say_en.text: Run a standup for these branches and give me a merge order.
say_en.note: Claude opens the room and lets branch agents speak.

say_en.text: Compare worktrees active in the last 24h and produce one integration plan.
say_en.note: Filters participants by the time window.

say_en.text: Do a standup over all open PRs and suggest one target branch.
say_en.note: Requires gh CLI on a GitHub repo.
